visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair tied back in a messy bun, secured with a black braided headband, sits on a light-colored fabric sofa. She wears a white vertical-striped button-down shirt. She looks directly into the lens with a neutral expression, then smiles slightly and touches her temples with both hands as if preparing for a facial routine. (2) She holds a translucent green spray bottle and closes her eyes while misting her face with multiple short sprays. Her face becomes visibly damp. She then uses the palms of both hands to gently and rhythmically pat her cheeks, chin, and forehead to help the moisture absorb into her skin. (3) The woman presents a small glass jar with a green lid containing numerous tiny pink pearl-like capsules of Annluya O3 essence. She unscrews the cap, picks up a single capsule, and holds it between her thumb and index finger. She then twists and squeezes the capsule over her palm to release a clear, viscous oil. (4) The woman applies the essence oil to her forehead and cheeks, using her fingers to massage her skin in gentle, upward circular motions. She closes her eyes and tilts her head back slightly, demonstrating a relaxing skincare experience. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features. (5) She holds up a light blue and white sheet mask packet. She tears it open along the top edge, pulls out the saturated white sheet mask, and carefully unfolds it. She applies the mask to her face, aligning the eye and mouth holes, and smooths out the edges against her skin. (6) After a quick cut, she removes the mask to reveal wet, glowing, and radiant skin. She winks at the camera and uses her fingers to point at her plump cheeks. The background remains the same indoor living room setting with a sofa and some decor. (7) The scene shifts to the woman now wearing a black scoop-neck top and a silver necklace, sitting at a wooden table. Multiple skincare bottles and a linen pouch are arranged in front of her. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and animated hand gestures. (8) Various text boxes containing positive customer feedback and reviews in Traditional Chinese appear as overlays on the left side of the screen. While she talks, a shirtless man briefly enters the frame from the left, playfully posing and eventually hugging her from behind. (9) She holds up the linen travel pouch and takes out several small travel-sized bottles, demonstrating their portability. A price comparison graphic appears at the bottom of the screen, showing the original price versus the discounted 11.11 price. She continues to speak enthusiastically until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal male voice begins narrating with a very fast speech rate and a playful, comedic tone. He uses exaggerated pitch contours to mimic the excitement of a beauty influencer. The background music is an upbeat, lighthearted acoustic guitar track with a moderate tempo of 110 BPM. (2) A sharp, hissing burst of sound occurs as the mist is sprayed, followed by a series of soft, percussive tapping sounds as the woman pats her face. The male narrator continues his high-pitched, teasing commentary, maintaining a very high level of vocal energy and dominance. (3) A distinct metallic-plastic clicking sound is heard when the essence jar is opened. The male narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability as he describes the product in a mock-serious tone. The BGM remains constant in volume and rhythm, providing a cheerful foundation. (4) The audio transitions to a primary female vocal with a moderate pitch and a professional, friendly delivery. Her articulation is extremely clear, suggesting a high-quality studio or quiet indoor recording. She describes the product's long-term benefits with a warm and convincing tone. (5) The female narrator's volume increases as she emphasizes specific skin improvements. In the background, the male voice can be heard laughing and making occasional high-pitched interjections, creating a sense of a lively, personal domestic environment. (6) A technical shift occurs as the female voice details the specifics of a sales promotion. Her speech rate remains steady, and her vocal arousal is moderate to high. The signal-to-noise ratio is excellent, with the voices clearly layered above the light instrumental background music. (7) The female speaker concludes with a high-arousal, rapid-fire call-to-action, encouraging viewers to take advantage of the limited-time offer. The acoustic guitar BGM continues with its bright, rhythmic texture until a clean hard cut ends the entire audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Storytelling: Hook -> Product Showcase -> Proof/Testimonial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a strategic marketing promotion for Annluya skincare products and an 11.11 shopping event. It utilizes a creative 'husband voiceover' hook to capture attention through humor, then shifts to the female creator's personal testimony to explain product efficacy and drive sales conversion via a limited-time offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand, demonstrates product usage, shares user reviews, and provides specific group-buy pricing and dates.
